## Summary

Describe the maintainer or security problem this change solves.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run bundle:action` (when action/scanner code changed)
- [ ] The generated `dist/action.cjs` is included when required

## Rule changes

- [ ] The rule has a stable identifier, precise remediation, and safe/unsafe tests.
- [ ] Potential false positives are documented.
